visual_review.description: Stage photograph with a linked line of women in blue garments leaning together, male musicians behind and a smaller performer at right. Bright stage lights; clear enough at native680px; no visible watermark. Caption must say festival performance, not an unposed village dance or a specific community inferred from dress.
